theme.title: Universal · Simón Bolívar · Institucional FINAL
theme.author: EducaMadrid · personalización cromática: Colegio Integrado Simón Bolívar
theme.description:
A web-accessibility–focused style for eXeLearning 4 designed to be compatible with Universal Design for Learning (UDL) principles. Created by Ignacio Gros for EducaMadrid. Day mode customized for Colegio Integrado Simón Bolívar: graphite, green and orange form the institutional structure; inactive navigation is neutral graphite, and a teal bridge (#2B6A72) leads visually toward the blue #0F5F9B used by the embedded 3D geometry resources. The original dark mode and functionality are preserved.
iDevice icons: "EducaAnd Escolares" style, by Consejería de Educación y Deporte (https://moocedu.juntadeandalucia.es/) for eXeLearning (http://exelearning.net/), cofinanced by FEDER funds.
